title: EngineSkillPreferences
description: Which toggleable origins are on, and which skills are off one by one — a user's own, or one folder's. Named without the engine, like every shared definition (plan 28, D-10): the engine's own routes say which one (plan 13, B-34, D-20).

sources.description: Which toggleable origins are on — absent or `false` is off (D-20's safety default).
